A: I had my signal on and I was backing out slowly. I checked my mirror, but a pickup was coming down the aisle

Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was moving?
A: Honestly, it wasn't fast, maybe a brisk walking pace for a car in a lot. But I didn't see it until it was already close.
Q: Did you exchange information with the other driver?
A: Yes, we swapped insuracne details and took a few photos of the bumpers.
Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?
A: My neck jerked forward and then back, and my lower back started aching within an hour or so. I didn't go to the
ER, but I went to my doctor the next day.
Q: What symptoms are you still having?
A: Stiffness in the morning, a dull ache across my shoulders, and sitting for long periods bothers my lower back. I've
been doing some stretching and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you had any proir neck or back problems?
A: Nothing serious. I had some occasional soreness years ago from lifting at work, but it cleraed up on its own.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm willing to follow up with my doctor and provide the records. I want this taken care of properly.
